mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the FEDFUNDS rate above 5.5% for two consecutive months predicts a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return due to tightened policy expectations.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are non-negative in at least 70% of similar trigger events, or FEDFUNDS does not exceed 5.5 for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Rising monthly PAYEMS accompanied by a decline in UNRATE over the next month signals labor market softening, which precedes S&P 500 positive 60-day returns.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > previous month AND UNRATE < previous month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in >50% of similar labor weakening events, or the PAYEMS-UNRATE relationship is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly rise in HOUST above 1,400 units indicates strengthening demand, which is associated with positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05) in 80% of high-HOUST months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in INDPRO below 100 (monthly) coincides with a negative 5-day S&P 500 forward return as weak manufacturing output anticipates market caution.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not negative in >60% of INDPRO < 100 months.

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL rises by more than 0.5% in a single month, the S&P 20-day forward return is expected to be negative due to inflation surprise.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in >70% of such CPIAUCSL jumps.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in PAYEMS and UNRATE above their 2023 averages for three months indicate labor market resilience, predicting positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > 2023_avg AND UNRATE > 2023_avg for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in 75% of such episodes.

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive monthly declines in RSAFS below 700,000 suggest softening business demand, which precedes negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not negative in >50% of low-RSAFS months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in FEDFUNDS for four consecutive months in a 'any regime' context is associated with positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns due to lower real rates.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05) in 80% of such four-month FEDFUNDS declines.
